propositions: MCP and review-bot mix static deployment policy with per-operation config and ambient auth reads, causing inconsistent rebinding across long-running processes
Static external material (Gerrit/GitHub/LLM/telemetry credentials) can change underneath in-flight operations and must be reread only on process restart
Inbound MCP bearer tokens and request-scoped auth must remain transient context, never persisted in startup config or operation snapshots
Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth before accepting a job, compose provider bindings once at startup, and pass focused runtime config into each operation without fallback principals
Telemetry setup (Langfuse/OTLP) must fail gracefully without changing operation results while security/load-bearing auth remains fail-closed
Service rotation must rebind static material only after restart/redeploy, not while running; native refreshable capabilities remain SDK-managed
